base: R1-R12 from ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW_2026-10-21.md section 2 (intended_arch.json); R13-R16 and the 2026-10-21 restatements from agent_memory_events.id=1230100
checker: chimera_omni.conformance (chimera-omni branch claude/arch-v2-20261021); R6, R10, R11, R12, R16 are process requirements it reports as unknown

requirements.title: one model, all modalities in and out
requirements.text: One model takes any modality in and produces any modality out: text, raw images, raw video, raw audio (speech and music), and 3D where feasible.
requirements.check: structural: token I/O plus one raw-unit boundary and one raw head in a single checkpoint; capability: per-modality evals

requirements.title: dense by default; MoE only if it wins at equal size
requirements.text: Dense. MoE is allowed only if evidence shows it beats dense at equal total size (owner very skeptical, 2026-10-21); converting a trained dense model into an MoE is never acceptable.

requirements.title: same token space and weights for every modality at every layer
requirements.text: Every modality uses the same token space and the same weights at every layer: every tensor of the network carries every modality.
requirements.check: census: no type-routed block, no type-indexed table; probe: each modality's loss reaches every trunk tensor

requirements.title: no encoders, decoders, adapters or codecs; raw media
requirements.text: No vision/audio encoders, VAEs, decoders, adapters or codecs in the shipped model: raw pixels, video frames, waveforms (and voxels) go in and come out.
requirements.check: no encoder/decoder/VAE/codec tensors, no codec vocabulary band, a raw-unit input projection

requirements.title: no modality towers or modality routing
requirements.text: No modality towers, no routing or type-gated modules by modality, no masking that turns one model into several.
requirements.check: census: no charted block or type table; probe: relabelling the media type ids leaves outputs bit-identical

requirements.title: K3 is the knowledge source; its architecture is inspiration
requirements.text: Kimi K3 is the main text and tool-calling knowledge source (teacher). Its architecture is inspiration only: a K3 mechanism is adopted only where an ablation proves it.
requirements.check: process: teacher weighting in the training recipe and ablation receipts in omni_lab

requirements.title: H3 (H3 SOL) absorbed for video and audio, encoder-free
requirements.text: Video and joint audio-video come from H3 (now 'H3 SOL', H3 + LTX) absorbed into the model, encoder-free: H3 quality at LTX speed.
requirements.check: structural: raw video and audio share the trunk and head; capability: AV evals against the H3 SOL teacher

requirements.title: 256k context
requirements.text: 256k-token context (target since 2026-09-01, restated 2026-10-21; earlier 1M targets are superseded).

requirements.title: standard GGUF / llama.cpp deployability
requirements.text: The finished weights are standard GGUF that runs in llama.cpp / LM Studio (and in the Sprite llama.cpp fork).
requirements.check: block kinds map to llama.cpp ops; chimera-omni GGUF export round-trips

requirements.title: intelligence before speed
requirements.text: Intelligence comes before speed: a twice-as-smart model beats a twice-as-fast one, and speed tricks that cost intelligence (e.g. trained sparse attention) are rejected.
requirements.check: process: every speed arm is gated on behaviour evals against the dense baseline

requirements.title: full-duplex speech
requirements.check: process: streaming speech eval on Sprite

requirements.title: tokenizer-agnostic corpus
requirements.text: The training corpus must not depend on one tokenizer: canonical records are text/structured; token corpora and teacher caches are derived views.

requirements.title: on-device first: 2B then 4B, Sprite-compatible
requirements.text: The first versions are on-device models for the Sprite app: start around 2B, then 4B, quantized later; every op must run on the Sprite runtime.
requirements.check: parameter count in the 2B-4B class; every block kind maps to a Hexagon/llama.cpp op; phone tok/s measured

requirements.title: about 99% of full attention, with depth; sparse only where it keeps quality
requirements.text: Keep about 99% of full-attention quality with more depth; no trained sparse attention in place of full attention. Some sparse-style speed is welcome only where it keeps that quality.
requirements.check: exact global attention in the schedule (linear:global <= 6:1); no csa/hca/local kinds; any sparse decode mode gated at >= 99% of dense

requirements.title: lookup-table memory only in a dense or fixed pattern
requirements.text: Engram-style lookup tables are acceptable only in a dense pattern or a fixed (unrouted) MoE-like pattern.
requirements.check: no routed lookup tables; any lookup table must be modality-symmetric (ablation A9)

requirements.title: v1 teacher set
requirements.text: Teachers for v1: K3 for text and tools, Qwen-Image 2.1 for images and editing, H3 SOL (H3 + LTX) for video and joint audio-video.
requirements.check: process: teacher provenance on every training run
